sloka: कारणानि च वक्ष्यामि महान्ति सदृशानि च ।यथेमौ जीवतो देवि भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४८.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: kāraṇāni ca vakṣyāmi mahānti sadṛśāni ca ।yathemau jīvato devi bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.48.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "If a husband ceases life in war, their face will not have an angry look or happy appearance."
